name: mordred-fated-luminary-non-attack-card-in-graveyard-cannot-ephemerate
notes: Mordred, Fated Luminary (KqBosnU7pU): "Attack cards in your graveyard have ... Ephemerate". A Dungeon Guide (an ally) in the graveyard is not an attack card: clicking it does nothing (no payment is requested, it stays in the graveyard).

rulesClauses: Only ATTACK cards in the graveyard gain Ephemerate.
